$description: Brasscribe design tokens: the single source for Play (Apple, Android, Windows) and Studio. Format: W3C Design Tokens (DTCG 2025.10). Modes are sibling groups under color: light, dark, high-contrast (on a dark ground) and high-contrast-light (on a light ground). Generate platform code with `uv run design/tokens/build.py`; check with `uv run qa/tools/contrast.py --tokens design/tokens/tokens.json`.

bg.$description: Window and page background; also the score paper.

surface.$description: Grouped areas: player bar, sidebars, list sections.

surface-raised.$description: Cards, sheets, dialogs and menus that sit above the background.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text. Still at least 4.5:1 on every surface.

border.$description: Decorative hairlines and dividers. Never the only boundary of a control.

border-strong.$description: Boundaries of controls (text fields, outlined buttons, chips). At least 3:1.

primary.$description: Fill of the one primary button per screen, selected chips and switches.

secondary.$description: Fill of secondary (tonal) buttons and segmented controls.

brass.$description: Brand colour. Logo, app icon, onboarding art and the wordmark only. Never inside the score or the review list.

brass-text.$description: Brand colour when it has to carry text, for example the product name under the wordmark.

brass-tint.$description: Background of brand moments: the onboarding hero and the About screen.

success.$description: Finished states: "Score ready", a passed Studio check. Always with text or an icon.

warning.$description: Notices that need attention but do not block. Always with text or an icon.

error.$description: Error text and the error icon. Always with a sentence that says what to do.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring: 2 px with a 2 px gap. Ink in light and paper in dark, so it can never be mistaken for the uncertain blue on notation. High contrast: yellow.

scrim.$description: Dimmed backdrop behind a sheet or dialog (40% alpha).

ink.$description: Noteheads, stems, clefs and confident notes.

uncertain.$description: Notes with confidence 0.4-0.7. Always with a "?" above the note.

very-uncertain.$description: Notes with confidence below 0.4. Always with a boxed "?" above the note.

adlib-tint.$description: Neutral band behind free-time (ad lib) bars; the italic "ad lib." and dashed bar lines carry the meaning. Not blue, so it never reads as uncertain. High contrast: none, outline instead.

loop-tint.$description: Band behind the loop range. High contrast: none, outline instead.

loop-edge.$description: Bracket markers at both ends of the loop range.

cursor.$description: Playback cursor: a 3 px full-staff-height line.

cursor-tint.$description: Tint of the bar under the playback cursor: the cursor colour at 20% over the paper.

selection-tint.$description: Band behind a selected bar range (before it becomes a loop).

selection-edge.$description: 1 px outline of a selected bar range.

model-1.$description: Studio data series 1 (MuScriptor). Always repeated by a pattern or label.

high-contrast-light.$description: High contrast on a light ground: black on white, every pair at 7:1 or more, tints become outlines. Used when more contrast is on and the resolved theme is light; high-contrast is its dark counterpart.

text.$description: The platform UI face. Apple: SF Pro (system). Android: Roboto (system). Windows: Segoe UI Variable (system). Studio: system-ui.

display.$description: Brand display face (SIL OFL 1.1), bundled from design/brand/fonts. Wordmark, onboarding and large screen titles at 28 px and up only. Never body text, labels or controls.

mono.$description: Studio identifiers, stage names, hashes. Play never shows monospace text.

typography.$description: Reference sizes in px are Apple points. Each role names the native text style per platform (Apple Dynamic Type style, Material 3 role with its sp size, Windows type-ramp style with its epx size). On each platform the native size wins, so text follows the system text-size setting.

display.$description: Brand headline: home greeting, onboarding, the What is this? question. Serif.

title-1.$description: Screen title when the display face is not used.

body.$description: Running text and list rows. Windows uses BodyLarge (18 epx) for Play; Studio uses 16 px.

numeric.$description: Bar/beat, speed and tempo readouts with tabular figures (monospacedDigit / tnum).

studio-body.$description: Studio body text: 16 px, line-height 1.5 (WCAG 1.4.12 baseline).

studio-meta.$description: Studio secondary text: hints, metadata, legends, table headers, keyboard keys. Studio's floor: nothing is smaller.

touch-min-windows.$description: Play's minimum target on Windows (epx); WinUI's own minimum is 32.

touch-min-web.$description: Studio's hit area (CSS px): 44, twice WCAG 2.5.8's 24.

control-min-web.$description: Studio's visible control height (CSS px); the hit area around it is touch-min-web.

target-gap-web.$description: Minimum space between adjacent Studio targets.

content-max.$description: Maximum width of a reading column (lists, forms, review).

sidebar.$description: Sidebar width on tablet and desktop.

sm.$description: Chips, text fields, segmented control segments.

md.$description: Buttons and list groups. The brand's one button shape on every platform.

xl.$description: Sheets and dialogs (top corners on phone).

full.$description: Only for circular transport buttons and status dots.

0.$description: Flat. Most surfaces: separation comes from colour and hairlines, not shadows.

1.$description: Cards on the background (light only; dark uses surface-raised plus a border).

slow.$description: Screen transitions. The upper limit anywhere.

reduced.$description: Reduced motion: cross-fade at most this long, or no animation.

focus-width.$description: Focus outline around a note or bar.

focus-gap.$description: Gap between the focused item and its outline.

loop-edge-width.$description: Width of the loop bracket markers.

mark-size-staff-spaces.$description: Height of the "?" mark in staff spaces.

staff-height-min-phone-mm.$description: Minimum staff height on phone at 100%, in millimetres.

single-part-reflow-zoom.$description: Above this zoom the score switches to one part, one staff, horizontal scrolling.
